title: Scala 2.9 support added
source_quote: This is the first release to support Scala 2.9 in addition to 2.8. Future releases are likely to be 2.9-only unless there is high demand for 2.8.

title: Save distributed datasets to HDFS/S3/Hypertable and other Hadoop-supported storage
source_quote: You can now save distributed datasets to the Hadoop filesystem (HDFS), Amazon S3, Hypertable, and any other storage system supported by Hadoop.

title: Native types for common Writable types in SequenceFiles
source_quote: Spark will now let you use native types for certain common Writable types, like IntWritable and Text.

title: Maven-based dependency fetching and artifact publishing
source_quote: Spark now fetches dependencies via Maven and can publish Maven artifacts for easier dependency management.

title: Faster broadcast and shuffle algorithms
source_quote:
This release includes broadcast and shuffle algorithms from
this paper
to better support applications that communicate large amounts of data.

title: SparkContext.hadoopRDD for non-filesystem Hadoop input formats
source_quote:
The new
SparkContext.hadoopRDD
method allows reading data from Hadoop-compatible storage systems other than file systems, such as HBase, Hypertable, etc.

title: Outer join operators added
source_quote:
Outer join operators (
leftOuterJoin
,
rightOuterJoin
, etc).

title: Scala 2.9 interpreter features supported
source_quote: Support for Scala 2.9 interpreter features (history search, Ctrl-C current line, etc) in the 2.9 version.

title: Better default parallelism levels for various operations
source_quote: Better default levels of parallelism for various operations.

title: Ability to control number of splits in a file
source_quote: Ability to control number of splits in a file.

title: Runs on Apache Mesos 0.9
source_quote:
This release runs on
Apache Mesos 0.9
, the first Apache Incubator release of Mesos, which contains significant usability and stability improvements.

title: Mesos 0.9 usability gains: memory accounting, job trace/log history, simpler install
source_quote: Most notable are better memory accounting for applications with long-term memory use, easier access of old jobs’ traces and logs (by keeping a history of executed tasks on the web UI), and simpler installation.

title: Scheduling made more communication-efficient for large lineage graphs
source_quote: scheduling is more communication-efficient when sending out operations on RDDs with large lineage graphs.

title: Improved cache replacement policy
source_quote: the cache replacement policy has been improved to more smartly replace data when an RDD does not fit in the cache

title: Shuffles made more efficient
source_quote: shuffles are more efficient

title: Configurable closure serializer
source_quote: the serializer used for shipping closures is now configurable, making it possible to use faster libraries than Java serialization there.

title: Worker exceptions reported back to master log
source_quote: Spark now reports exceptions on the worker nodes back to the master, so you can see them all in one log file.

title: Automatic marking/filtering of duplicate errors
source_quote: It also automatically marks and filters duplicate errors.

title: New operators: sortByKey, takeSample, faster fold/aggregate
source_quote:
These include
sortByKey
for parallel sorting,
takeSample
, and more efficient
fold
and
aggregate

title: Join of identically hash-partitioned RDDs avoids network shuffle
source_quote:
more of the old operators make use of, and retain, RDD partitioning information to reduce communication cost. For example, if you
join
two hash-partitioned RDDs that were partitioned in the same way, Spark will not shuffle any data across the network.

title: EC2 launch scripts bundled with release and auto-discover latest AMI
source_quote: EC2 launch scripts are now included in the main package, and have the ability to discover and use the latest Spark AMI automatically instead of launching a hardcoded machine image ID.

title: New Hadoop API (org.apache.mapreduce) read/write support
source_quote:
You can now use Spark to read and write data to storage formats in the new
org.apache.mapreduce
packages (the “new Hadoop” API).

title: Spark published to Maven Central
source_quote: Spark is now available in Maven Central, making it easier to link into your programs without having to build it as a JAR.

title: Builds against Scala 2.9.2 by default
source_quote: Spark now builds against Scala 2.9.2 by default.

title: New Accumulable class generalizes Accumulators for non-matching element/accumulated types
source_quote: The new Accumulable class generalizes Accumulators for the case when the type being accumulated is not the same as the types of elements being added (e.g. you wish to accumulate a collection, such as a Set, by adding individual elements). This interface is also more efficient in avoiding the creation of temporary objects.

title: Improved object size estimation for memory management (32/64-bit pointers)
source_quote:
algorithm for estimating the sizes of objects (in order to manage memory correctly) has been improved
    to handle JVMs with 32- vs 64-bit pointers and to measure objects more accurately.

title: Improved random sampling algorithm to avoid bias
source_quote: Improved algorithms for taking random samples out of datasets to avoid biases that could occur in the previous ones.

title: Improved load balancing across nodes in sort operations
source_quote: Improved load balancing across nodes in sort operations.

title: Reduced memory consumption of saveAsObjectFile for large objects
source_quote:
Reduced memory consumption of
saveAsObjectFile
when objects are large.

title: EC2 launch script auto-configures memory limit from instance RAM
source_quote: EC2 launch script now configures Spark’s memory limit automatically based on the machine’s available RAM.

title: Compile support for Hadoop 2 distributions
source_quote: Spark 0.5.2 is a minor release, whose main addition is to allow Spark to compile against Hadoop 2 distributions.

title: Standalone deploy mode added
source_quote:
Spark now has a
standalone deploy mode
that lets you quickly launch a cluster without installing an external cluster manager.

title: Experimental YARN support
source_quote:
there is
experimental support for running on YARN
(Hadoop NextGen), currently in a separate branch.

title: Java API layer added
source_quote:
Java programmers can now use Spark through a new
Java API layer

title: New async Java NIO communication manager speeds up shuffle
source_quote: A new communication manager using asynchronous Java NIO lets shuffle operations run faster, especially when sending large amounts of data or when jobs have many tasks.

title: New storage manager with per-dataset storage level settings
source_quote: A new storage manager supports per-dataset storage level settings (e.g. whether to keep the dataset in memory, deserialized, on disk, etc, or even replicated across nodes).

title: Scheduler and control plane optimized for ultra-low-latency jobs
source_quote: scheduler and control plane have been optimized to better support ultra-low-latency jobs (under 500ms) and high-throughput scheduling decisions.

title: Per-RDD storage level control via persist()
source_quote:
This release adds the ability to control caching strategies on a per-RDD level, so that different RDDs may be stored in memory, on disk, as serialized bytes, etc. You can choose your storage level using the
persist()
method

title: New Accumulable class for accumulating collections/mismatched types
source_quote: A new Accumulable class generalizes Accumulators for the case when the type being accumulated is not the same as the types of elements being added (e.g. you wish to accumulate a collection, such as a Set, by adding individual elements).

title: Dynamic file/JAR shipping via SparkContext.addFile/Jar
source_quote:
You can now dynamically add files or JARs that should be shipped to your workers with
SparkContext.addFile/Jar

title: More operators (e.g. joins) support custom partitioners
source_quote: More Spark operators (e.g. joins) support custom partitioners.

title: Log now records which program operation produced each RDD/job for easier debugging
source_quote: log now prints which operation in your program each RDD and job described in your logs belongs to, making it easier to tie back to which parts of your code experience problems.

title: Spark published to Maven Central
source_quote: Spark is now available in Maven Central, making it easier to link into your programs without having to build it as a JAR.

title: Improved connection reuse speeds up small shuffles
source_quote: Improved connection reuse in shuffle, which can greatly speed up small shuffles

title: Support for Hadoop 2 distributions
source_quote: Support for Hadoop 2 distributions (contributed by Thomas Dudziak)

title: Support for locating Scala on Debian distributions
source_quote: Support for locating Scala on Debian distributions (contributed by Thomas Dudziak)

title: Improved standalone cluster web UI shows more job information
source_quote: Improved standalone cluster web UI to show more information about jobs

title: spark.deploy.spreadOut option to spread jobs across the standalone cluster
source_quote:
Added an option to spread out jobs over the standalone cluster instead of concentrating them on a small number of nodes (
spark.deploy.spreadOut

title: Customizable local IP address binding
source_quote: Made the local IP address that Spark binds to customizable (contributed by Mikhail Bautin)

title: EC2 script improvements including better spot instance handling
source_quote: Several EC2 script improvements, like better handling of spot instances (contributed by Josh Rosen)

title: EC2 support for launching a cluster across multiple availability zones
source_quote: Support for launching a cluster across multiple availability zones in the EC2 scripts

title: EC2 support for deleting security groups on cluster termination
source_quote: Support for deleting security groups when an EC2 cluster is terminated

title: Separate SPARK_DAEMON_MEMORY variable for standalone daemon memory config
source_quote:
Improved memory configuration for the standalone deploy cluster daemons: instead of using
SPARK_MEM
for their memory, which often led people to give them much more memory than they intended, they now use a separate variable,
SPARK_DAEMON_MEMORY
, with a reasonable default of 512 MB

title: Connection reuse bug fix improves shuffle performance
source_quote: A connection reuse bug fix that improves shuffle performance

title: Better detection of a machine's external IP address
source_quote: Better detection of a machine's external IP address

title: Python API (PySpark) added
source_quote:
Spark 0.7 adds a
Python API
called PySpark that makes it possible to use Spark from Python, both in standalone programs and in interactive Python shells.

title: PySpark supports RDDs, accumulators, broadcast variables, and HDFS I/O
source_quote: PySpark supports most Spark features, including RDDs, accumulators, broadcast variables, and HDFS input and output.

title: Spark Streaming alpha introduced
source_quote: Spark Streaming is a new extension of Spark that adds near-real-time processing capability.

title: Streaming API: map/filter/reduce plus sliding window functions
source_quote:
It offers a simple and high-level API, where users can transform streams using parallel operations like
map
,
filter
,
reduce
, and new sliding window functions.

title: Streaming fault recovery with exactly-once semantics, no external transactions
source_quote: It automatically distributes work over a cluster and provides efficient fault recovery with exactly-once semantics for transformations, without relying on costly transactions to an external system.

title: Web-based memory usage dashboard for RDDs
source_quote: Spark jobs now launch a web dashboard for monitoring the memory usage of each distributed dataset (RDD) in the program.

title: Configurable UI port via spark.ui.port
source_quote:
You can also control which port to use through the
spark.ui.port
property.

title: Maven build support added
source_quote: Spark can now be built using Maven in addition to SBT.

title: New RDD transformations: keys, values, keyBy, subtract, coalesce, zip
source_quote:
This release adds several RDD transformations, including
keys
,
values
,
keyBy
,
subtract
,
coalesce
,
zip

title: SparkContext.hadoopConfiguration for global Hadoop I/O settings
source_quote:
It also adds
SparkContext.hadoopConfiguration
to allow programs to configure Hadoop input/output settings globally across operations.

title: RDD.toDebugString() prints RDD lineage graph for troubleshooting
source_quote:
RDD.toDebugString()
method, which can be used to print an RDD’s lineage graph for troubleshooting.

title: S3 credentials read from AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY env vars
source_quote:
Spark will now read S3 credentials from the
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
and
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environment variables, if set, making it easier to access Amazon S3.

title: EC2 scripts support standalone and Mesos clusters, launch Ganglia
source_quote: The EC2 scripts now support both standalone and Mesos clusters, and launch Ganglia on the cluster.

title: EC2 clusters can span multiple availability zones
source_quote: Spark EC2 clusters can now be spread across multiple availability zones.

title: Shuffle ops infer parallelism from parent RDD size
source_quote:
Shuffle operations like
groupByKey
and
reduceByKey
now try to infer parallelism from the size of the parent RDD (unless
spark.default.parallelism
is set).

title: Several shuffle performance improvements
source_quote: Several performance improvements to shuffles.

title: Standalone deploy spreads jobs across machines for better data locality
source_quote: Standalone deploy cluster now spreads jobs out across machines by default, leading to better data locality.

title: Better error reporting when jobs cannot launch due to insufficient resources
source_quote: Better error reporting when jobs aren't being launched due to not enough resources.

title: Standalone web UI adds JSON endpoints for cluster state
source_quote: Standalone deploy web UI now includes JSON endpoints for querying cluster state.

title: Better support for IBM JVM
source_quote: Better support for IBM JVM.

title: Default Hadoop version dependency updated to 1.0.4
source_quote: Default Hadoop version dependency updated to 1.0.4.

title: Improved failure handling and error message reporting
source_quote: Improved failure handling and reporting of error messages.

title: Separate configuration for standalone daemons vs user applications
source_quote: Separate configuration for standalone cluster daemons and user applications.

title: Scheduler codebase refactored to enable richer unit testing
source_quote: Significant refactoring of the scheduler codebase to enable richer unit testing.

title: SparkFiles.getRootDirectory/SparkFiles.get for locating shipped files
source_quote:
you can find the directory it used using
SparkFiles.get

title: Scala version updated to 2.9.3
source_quote: Scala version updated to 2.9.3.

title: Bagel improvements: performance fixes and configurable storage level
source_quote: Several improvements to Bagel, including performance fixes and a configurable storage level.

title: New API methods: subtractByKey, foldByKey, mapWith, filterWith, foreachPartition
source_quote: New API methods: subtractByKey, foldByKey, mapWith, filterWith, foreachPartition, and others.

title: SparkListener metrics interface for per-stage computation info
source_quote: A new metrics reporting interface, SparkListener, to collect information about each computation stage: task lengths, bytes shuffled, etc.

title: Support for launching multiple worker instances per host in standalone mode
source_quote: Support for launching multiple worker instances per host in the standalone mode.

title: ADD_JARS environment variable adds JARs to spark-shell and workers
source_quote:
Users of
spark-shell
can now set the
ADD_JARS
environment variable to add a list of JARs to their clusters; these will also be sent to workers.

title: Windows: standalone clusters properly kill executors; JAR paths with backslashes work
source_quote: Spark standalone clusters now properly kill executors when a job ends or fails. In addition, adding JAR paths with backslashes will now work correctly.

title: Streaming Kafka/Twitter APIs updated (OAuth, non-string Kafka messages)
source_quote: The Kafka and Twitter APIs for Spark Streaming have been updated. In the Twitter case, this is to deal with the username/password authentication method being disabled in by Twitter, while in the Kafka case, it is to allow receiving messages other than strings.

title: Faster Python VM spawning for large JVM heap sizes
source_quote: mechanism for spawning Python VMs has been improved to do so faster when the JVM has a large heap size, speeding up the Python API.

title: Better error reporting for non-serializable exceptions and large task results
source_quote: Better error reporting for non-serializable exceptions and overly large task results.

title: Spark Streaming build no longer depends on Twitter4J repo
source_quote: Spark Streaming no longer depends on the Twitter4J repo, which should allow it to build in China.

title: Web UI for monitoring at port 4040
source_quote: Spark now displays a variety of monitoring data in a web UI (by default at port 4040 on the driver node).

title: Job dashboard with percentile stats for task runtime, shuffle, GC
source_quote: A new job dashboard contains information about running, succeeded, and failed jobs, including percentile statistics covering task runtime, shuffled data, and garbage collection.

title: Extended storage dashboard with per-executor storage/task pages
source_quote: The existing storage dashboard has been extended, and additional pages have been added to display total storage and task information per-executor.

title: New metrics library exposing internal metrics via JMX and Ganglia
source_quote: Finally, a new metrics library exposes internal Spark metrics through various APIâs including JMX and Ganglia.

title: MLlib machine learning library introduced
source_quote: This release introduces MLlib, a standard library of high-quality machine learning and optimization algorithms for Spark.

title: MLlib ships seven algorithms (SVM, logistic regression, linear regression variants, KMeans, ALS)
source_quote: The current library contains seven algorithms, including support vector machines (SVMs), logistic regression, several regularized variants of linear regression, a clustering algorithm (KMeans), and alternating least squares collaborative filtering.

title: Python API extended with storage levels, sampling, and missing RDD operators
source_quote: The Python API has been extended with many previously missing features. This includes support for different storage levels, sampling, and various missing RDD operators.

title: PySpark support for IPython (incl. Notebook) and Windows
source_quote:
also added support for running Spark in
IPython
, including the IPython Notebook, and for running PySpark on Windows.

title: YARN support improved and promoted from experimental to mainline
source_quote: Spark 0.8 add greatly improved support for running standalone Spark jobs on a YARN cluster. The YARN support is no longer experimental but now part of mainline Spark.

title: Support for running against a secured YARN cluster
source_quote: Support for running against a secured YARN cluster has also been added.

title: Job scheduler refactored with fair scheduler for multi-user sharing
source_quote:
internal job scheduler has been refactored and extended to include more sophisticated scheduling policies. In particular, a
fair scheduler
implementation now allows multiple users to share an instance of Spark, which helps users running shorter jobs to achieve good performance, even when longer-running jobs are running in parallel.

title: Topology-aware scheduling extended: rack locality and multiple executors per machine
source_quote: Support for topology-aware scheduling has been extended, including the ability to take into account rack locality and support for multiple executors on a single machine.

title: Link to Spark for any Hadoop version via hadoop-client dependency
source_quote:
User programs can now link to Spark no matter which Hadoop version they need, without having to publish a version of
spark-core
specifically for that Hadoop version.

title: EC2 scripts support any availability zone and HVM instance types
source_quote: EC2 scripts now support launching in any availability zone. Support has also been added for EC2 instance types which use the newer âHVMâ architecture. This includes the cluster compute (cc1/cc2) family of instance types.

title: EC2 support for running newer HDFS versions alongside Spark
source_quote: also added support for running newer versions of HDFS alongside Spark.

title: EC2 ability to launch clusters with maintenance releases of Spark
source_quote: added the ability to launch clusters with maintenance releases of Spark in addition to launching the newest release.

title: unpersist() to manually drop RDDs from memory
source_quote:
RDDs can now manually be dropped from memory with
unpersist

title: New RDD operations: takeOrdered, zipPartitions, top
source_quote:
The RDD class includes the following new operations:
takeOrdered
,
zipPartitions
,
top

title: JobLogger class for archivable workload logs
source_quote:
JobLogger
class has been added to produce archivable logs of a Spark workload.

title: RDD.coalesce now takes locality into account
source_quote:
RDD.coalesce
function now takes into account locality.

title: RDD.pipe supports passing environment variables to child processes
source_quote:
RDD.pipe
function has been extended to support passing environment variables to child processes.

title: Hadoop save functions support optional compression codec
source_quote: functions now support an optional compression codec.

title: Binary distribution depending only on a Java runtime
source_quote: You can now create a binary distribution of Spark which depends only on a Java runtime for easier deployment on a cluster.

title: Examples build isolated from core build to reduce dependency conflicts
source_quote: The examples build has been isolated from the core build, substantially reducing the potential for dependency conflicts.

title: Streaming Twitter API updated to use OAuth authentication
source_quote: The Spark Streaming Twitter API has been updated to use OAuth authentication instead of the deprecated username/password authentication in Spark 0.7.0.

title: Mesos: deploy assembly JAR as part of job (no pre-install needed); default Mesos 0.13
source_quote: Support for running on Mesos has been improved – now you can deploy a Spark assembly JAR as part of the Mesos job, instead of having Spark pre-installed on each machine. The default Mesos version has also been updated to 0.13.

title: Various optimizations to PySpark and the job scheduler
source_quote: This release includes various optimizations to PySpark and to the job scheduler.

title: YARN 2.2+ support added
source_quote: Support has been added for running Spark on YARN 2.2 and newer.

title: Standalone cluster manager gains Zookeeper-based high availability (H/A) mode
source_quote: The standalone cluster manager now has a high availability (H/A) mode which can tolerate master failures.

title: Optimized hashtables for shuffle data reduce memory/CPU use
source_quote: Optimized hashtables for shuffle data - reduces memory and CPU consumption

title: Efficient JobConf encoding improves latency reading many HDFS/S3/HBase blocks
source_quote: Efficient encoding for JobConfs - improves latency for stages reading large numbers of blocks from HDFS, S3, and HBase

title: Shuffle file consolidation reduces file count in large shuffles
source_quote: Shuffle file consolidation (off by default) - reduces the number of files created in large shuffles for better filesystem performance.

title: Torrent broadcast: faster broadcast implementation for large objects
source_quote: Torrent broadcast (off by default) - a faster broadcast implementation for large objects.

title: Support for fetching large result sets without tuning Akka buffer sizes
source_quote: Support for fetching large result sets - allows tasks to return large results without tuning Akka buffer sizes.

title: New ALS variant for implicit feedback matrix factorization
source_quote: Added a new variant of Alternating Least Squares matrix factorization for implicit feedback.

title: Set Spark config properties directly from Python
source_quote: It is now possible to set Spark config properties directly from Python

title: Python support for sort operations
source_quote: Python now supports sort operations

title: Python accumulators gain an explicitly named add method
source_quote:
Accumulators now have an explicitly named
add
method

title: local:// URIs for referencing files already present on slaves
source_quote:
local://
URIâs - allows users to specify files already present on slaves as dependencies

title: New result-fetching state shown in UI
source_quote: A new âresult fetchingâ state has been added to the UI

title: New Streaming operators: transformWith, leftInnerJoin, rightOuterJoin
source_quote:
New Spark Streaming operators:
transformWith
,
leftInnerJoin
,
rightOuterJoin

title: New repartition operator
source_quote:
New Spark operators:
repartition

title: Run Spark applications as a different user in standalone and Mesos modes
source_quote: You can now run Spark applications as a different user in standalone and Mesos modes

title: Spark runs on Scala 2.10
source_quote: Spark now runs on Scala 2.10, letting users benefit from the language and library improvements in this version.

title: New SparkConf class for configuring SparkContext settings
source_quote:
The new
SparkConf
class is now the preferred way to configure advanced settings on your SparkContext, though the previous Java system property method still works.

title: Spark Streaming graduates out of alpha with simplified HA and optimizations
source_quote: Spark Streaming is now out of alpha, and comes with simplified high availability and several optimizations.

title: Streaming driver auto-recovery via standalone cluster HA mode
source_quote: you can submit a Spark Streaming driver application to the cluster and have it automatically recovered if either the driver or the cluster master crashes.

title: Windowed operators sped up by 30-50%
source_quote: Windowed operators have been sped up by 30-50%.

title: Streaming input source plugins split into separate Maven modules
source_quote: input source plugins (e.g. for Twitter, Kafka and Flume) are now separate Maven modules, making it easier to pull in only the dependencies you need.

title: New StreamingListener interface for monitoring streaming statistics
source_quote:
StreamingListener
interface has been added for monitoring statistics about the streaming computation.

title: StreamingContext.awaitTermination() waits for shutdown and surfaces exceptions
source_quote:
StreamingContext.awaitTermination()
allows you wait for context shutdown and catch any exception that occurs in the streaming computation.

title: StreamingContext.stop() can stop streaming without stopping the SparkContext
source_quote:
StreamingContext.stop()
now allows stopping of StreamingContext without stopping the underlying SparkContext.

title: GraphX graph-processing framework introduced (alpha)
source_quote: is a new framework for graph processing that uses recent advances in graph-parallel computation. It lets you build a graph within a Spark program using the standard Spark operators, then process it with new graph operators that are optimized for distributed computation.

title: GraphX: build graphs from arbitrary Spark RDDs
source_quote: Building graphs from arbitrary Spark RDDs

title: GraphX: basic operations to transform graphs or extract subgraphs
source_quote: Basic operations to transform graphs or extract subgraphs

title: GraphX: optimized Pregel API using graph partitioning and indexing
source_quote: An optimized Pregel API that takes advantage of graph partitioning and indexing

title: GraphX standard algorithms: PageRank, connected/strongly-connected components, SVD++, triangle counting
source_quote:
Standard algorithms including
PageRank
,
connected components
,
strongly connected components
,
SVD++
, and
triangle counting

title: GraphX interactive use from the Spark shell
source_quote: Interactive use from the Spark shell

title: MLlib available in Python (NumPy-based)
source_quote:
machine learning library (MLlib) is now
available in Python
, where it operates on NumPy data (currently requires Python 2.7 and NumPy 1.7)

title: New Naive Bayes classification algorithm
source_quote:
A new algorithm has been added for
Naive Bayes classification

title: ALS models predict ratings for multiple items in parallel
source_quote: Alternating Least Squares models can now be used to predict ratings for multiple items in parallel

title: PySpark shows job call sites in the Spark application UI
source_quote:
PySpark now shows the call sites of running jobs in the Spark application UI (http://
:4040), making it easy to see which part of your code is running

title: IPython integration updated for newer versions
source_quote: IPython integration has been updated to work with newer versions

title: Scripts reorganized into bin and sbin directories
source_quote: scripts have been organized into âbinâ and âsbinâ directories to make it easier to separate admin scripts from user ones and install Spark on standard Linux paths.

title: Auto-discovery of default log4j.properties file
source_quote: Log configuration has been improved so that Spark finds a default log4j.properties file if you donât specify one.

title: Standalone mode supports submitting driver programs to run on the cluster
source_quote:
standalone mode now supports submitting a driver program to run on the cluster instead of on the external machine submitting it. You can access this functionality through the
org.apache.spark.deploy.Client
class.

title: Large reduce operations automatically spill to disk
source_quote: Large reduce operations now automatically spill data to disk if it does not fit in memory.

title: Standalone mode can limit default cores per application
source_quote: Users of standalone mode can now limit how many cores an application will use by default if the application writer didnât configure its size. Previously, such applications took all available cores on the cluster.

title: spark-shell -i option to run a startup script
source_quote:
spark-shell
now supports the
-i
option to run a script on startup.

title: New histogram and countDistinctApprox operators
source_quote:
histogram
and
countDistinctApprox
operators have been added for working with numerical data.

title: YARN mode supports distributing extra files with the application
source_quote: YARN mode now supports distributing extra files with the application, and several bugs have been fixed.

title: Distribution tarballs can bundle Tachyon for easier deployment
source_quote: Added the ability to make distribution tarballs with Tachyon bundled in them. This eases the deployment of Spark with Tachyon.

title: Support for HBase's TableOutputFormat and other Configurable OutputFormats
source_quote: Added support for HBaseâs TableOutputFormat and other OutputFormats that extend Configurable

title: EC2 scripts support C3 instance types
source_quote: Added support for C3 EC2 instances were added to Sparkâs EC2 scripts used to launch EC2 clusters.

title: Optimized ALS memory usage
Optimized YtY computation for implicit ALS
Support for negative implicit input in ALS
Ability to set a random seed in ALS
Faster construction of features with intercept
Missing RDD operations added to PySpark (top, zip, foldByKey, repartition, coalesce, getStorageLevel, setName, toDebugString)
source_quote: Added Missing RDD operations to PySpark - top, zip, foldByKey, repartition, coalesce, getStorageLevel, setName and toDebugString

title: YARN/Hadoop security integration (job auth, HDFS creds, component auth)
source_quote: For users running in secured Hadoop environments, Spark now integrates with the Hadoop/YARN security model. Spark will authenticate job submission, securely transfer HDFS credentials, and authenticate communication between components.

title: spark-submit tool for unified application submission
source_quote:
A new
spark-submit tool
allows users to submit an application to any Spark cluster, including local clusters, Mesos, or YARN, through a common process.

title: History server added for Spark's web UI
source_quote: also added a history server for  Sparkâs web UI, allowing users to view Spark application data after individual applications are finished.

title: Spark SQL introduced as new alpha component
source_quote:
This release introduces
Spark SQL
as a new alpha component. Spark SQL provides support for loading and manipulating structured data in Spark, either from external structured data sources (currently Hive and Parquet) or by adding a schema to an existing RDD.

title: Spark SQL API interoperates with the RDD data model
